$comment: What the bundle audit (scripts/audit-plugin.mjs, docs/spec-v1.md section 12a, Data protection) lets through. Every entry says why it can't reach the network. Add one only with its reason; the audit fails on anything else.

hosts.www.w3.org: XML namespaces (SVG, XHTML, XLink, MathML): names, never fetched
hosts.react.dev: React's error messages name their help page in the thrown text; never fetched
hosts.github.com: Licence comments, Excalidraw's Help and dialog links, jotai's and zustand's warning texts, and the app's Report this error link (the new-issue page, nothing filled in); a link opens the browser only when clicked
hosts.docs.excalidraw.com: Excalidraw's Help dialog link; opens the browser only when clicked
hosts.plus.excalidraw.com: Excalidraw's Help dialog link (blog); opens the browser only when clicked
hosts.www.youtube.com: Excalidraw's Help link, and its embed patterns, which never load: the plugin passes validateEmbeddable false
hosts.youtube.com: Excalidraw's embed patterns; never loaded (validateEmbeddable false)
hosts.discord.gg: Excalidraw's Help dialog link; opens the browser only when clicked
hosts.x.com: Excalidraw's Help link and embed pattern; never loaded (validateEmbeddable false)
hosts.twitter.com: Excalidraw's embed pattern; never loaded (validateEmbeddable false)
hosts.platform.twitter.com: Excalidraw's tweet embed script, written only into an embed's iframe; never loaded (validateEmbeddable false)
hosts.player.vimeo.com: Excalidraw's embed pattern; never loaded (validateEmbeddable false)
hosts.www.figma.com: Excalidraw's embed pattern; never loaded (validateEmbeddable false)
hosts.reddit.com: Excalidraw's embed pattern; never loaded (validateEmbeddable false)
hosts.embed.reddit.com: Excalidraw's embed pattern; never loaded (validateEmbeddable false)
hosts.giphy.com: Excalidraw's embed pattern; never loaded (validateEmbeddable false)
hosts.gist.github.com: Excalidraw's embed pattern; never loaded (validateEmbeddable false)
hosts.drive.google.com: Excalidraw's embed pattern for a Google Drive video, and the address it gives that embed's iframe; never loaded (validateEmbeddable false)
hosts.www.instagram.com: The address Excalidraw gives an Instagram embed's iframe; never loaded (validateEmbeddable false)
hosts.libraries.excalidraw.com: A link in Excalidraw's Publish library dialog, which the plugin never opens
hosts.mermaid.js.org: Links in Excalidraw's Mermaid dialog, which is trimmed from the plugin

text.$comment: A name that holds a forbidden word and is no use of it. The audit takes each out of the text before it counts the forbidden words, so the word anywhere else still fails.
text.localStorageQuotaExceeded: The name of one of Excalidraw's messages ("Browser storage quota exceeded. Changes will not be saved."), in its English texts and in every locale kept. A key in a table of texts reads and writes nothing, and no code in Excalidraw's package asks for the message: excalidraw.com's own app does, for its own browser storage

elementCreation.$comment: Each createElement("style" | "link") must sit near one of these words, which mark library code the app never reaches. The network-blocked run also fails on any <style> or <link> added at run time.
elementCreation.precedence: React DOM's hoisting of <style> and <link> written in JSX; the app renders none
elementCreation.preload: React DOM's preload resources (ReactDOM.preload, <link rel=preload> in JSX); the app uses neither
elementCreation.dns-prefetch: React DOM's ReactDOM.prefetchDNS; the app never calls it
elementCreation.__webpack_nonce__: react-style-singleton, which Radix's scroll lock uses only in a modal; the blocked run watches for it
